title: fix(spec): translateView localizes a form view's sections through objects.OBJECT._sections.NAME
body:
Fixes #23632

Clause-②: no

## What this does

`translateView` (and `translateMetadataDocument('view', …)`, which dispatches to it) now localizes a served form view's `sections`. Each named section's `label` and `description` resolve through `objects.OBJECT._sections.NAME.label` / `.description`, on the same `localeChain` / `pickData` every other resolver in `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` uses. No new export: the card's first option ("`translateView` covers a form view's `sections`").

- A missing key keeps the authored text, as the sibling resolvers do.
- A section with no `name` has no key and is returned as the same object. Its label is never slugged into a key: the slug-of-label fallback in the `metadataForms.TYPE.sections` walk belongs to a different namespace and a different rule, and the translation linter refuses that spelling for `_sections`.
- An explicit override beats the catalog (#20731, ADR-0029 D9.2a). Each section is found in `packagedBase.config.sections` by the `name` the bundle addresses it by, through the existing `packagedPart` finder (its key union gains `'sections'`). The comparison is the existing `valueOverridesPackagedBase`, with no second copy. A section the base does not carry was authored after the fact and keeps its strings. With no base supplied, the catalog applies.
- Only authored copy is translated (see the decision note below).
- The object is the form's own binding (`config.data.object`) first, then the view's. That is the order the i18n extractor (`walkObjectSections`) and the translation linter (`collectViewRecord`) already use for form sections, so the key read here is the key they scaffold and accept.

`config` is rebuilt only when a def or a section actually moved. A view with no section translation keeps its `config` reference, as before.

## Measured readings (dispatch Zone 2)

All against `origin/main` `534ca13eb` (the branch base).

1. **`translateView` never read `sections`: confirmed.** From `translateView` to `translateMetadataDocument`, the base holds 0 occurrences of `sections`. The resolver's only other `sections` walk is `resolveMetadataFormLabels` (`metadataForms.TYPE.sections`). It is a different namespace with a slug-of-label fallback, so it is not the same rule and was not reused.
2. **The key is declared.** `translation.zod.ts` declares `_sections` (`label`, `description`) on `ObjectTranslationDataSchema`, and `component.zod.ts` declares section `name` as the `_sections` anchor (`record:details` and `object-form` sections). The form view's own `FormSectionSchema.name` (`ui/view.zod.ts`) says only "Stable section identifier for i18n lookup". Its TSDoc points at `metadataForms.TYPE.sections.NAME`, which see the acceptance notes below.
3. **Where a served form view carries its sections: `config.sections`.** `getMetaItems({ type: 'view' })` filters every aggregated container out (`metadata-protocol` `protocol.ts`, "Never surface the aggregated … container"). So every element `GET /forms/:slug` scans is a ViewItem, and `anonymousFormIntakeCandidates`'s `config` arm (`viewKind === 'form'`) is the one that matches there: `match.form === match.view.config`. `ListViewSchema` refuses a `sections` key (`unrecognized_keys`, measured against the built package), so `config.sections` exists only on the form arm, and no `viewKind` gate is needed.
   - **The call #23497 makes:** `translateMetadataDocument('view', match.view, bundle, { ...RestServer.translateOptionsFor(i18n, locale), packagedBase: this.packagedObjectBase(p, 'view', match.view.name) })`. The route then serves the translated view's `config` as `form`, before its existing field strip. That is the same pair of arguments the object half of the same handler already passes.
4. **Override rule: holds, with a stable identity.** A section's packaged counterpart is found by `name`, the key the bundle addresses. A nameless section is never translated, so it needs no identity.
5. **The `metadataForms` walk: a different rule**, see 1.
6. **Consumers** (`git grep -l "translateMetadataDocument\|translateView" -- packages ':!packages/spec'`): the runtime callers are in `packages/rest/src` (`meta-item-read-gate.ts`, `rest-server.ts`). `metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` names `translateView` in a comment only. The rest are tests (`objectql`, `platform-objects`, `plugin-approvals`, `service-i18n`, `cli`). Readings are under Tests.

## Decision: the catalog never adds a heading or a description

A section that authors no `label` stays without one, and the same holds for `description`, even when the bundle carries `_sections.NAME.label`. The card's pins do not decide this case, so here is the reason. The public form renderer (objectui `FormPage`) draws a heading only under `sec.label &&`, and its comment rules that "a translation cannot conjure a heading the author did not write". A label added here would draw a heading on the anonymous route only. The authenticated `FormPage` path would draw none for the same form. Pinned, and ablated below. The alternative is to overlay whatever the bundle carries, the way the view's own `description` is overlaid. That would be a one-line change if ruled otherwise.

## Tests

- New `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.form-sections.test.ts`, 13 cases. The fixtures are spec-legal: the container passes `ViewSchema.safeParse` and each bundle object node passes `ObjectTranslationDataSchema.safeParse`. The served documents come from `expandViewContainer`. Cases: the card's three pins, the only-authored-copy rule, an inline locale-map heading, the form's own binding, the locale chain (BCP-47 ladder, declared fallback chain, default locale), `config` reference identity and no mutation, and four override-rule cases (unedited, edited per string, not in base, no base).
- Readings, all at head `4abffa0fb`, each command run through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`:
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2`: 680 files, 20769 passed, 1 todo.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0. `check:test-typecheck` OK, and the new test file adds no signature to `test-typecheck-debt.json`.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` (after a real `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`): all 14 artifacts up to date, `check:api-surface` included. So no export, parameter or type widens, and `Clause-②: no` holds as measured.
  - Consumer tests that read translated views, built against this head's `dist` (`turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/rest^...'`). The checks below ran per package, by file:
    - `@objectstack/rest`, 9 files, 166 passed: `meta-view-container-i18n`, `meta-dashboard-view-i18n-explicit-override`, `meta-i18n-declared-fallback-chain`, `meta-plural-i18n`, and the five `public-form-*` suites.
    - `@objectstack/objectql`, 2 files, 16 passed: `protocol-packaged-view-base`, `engine-validation-locale-negotiation`.
    - `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, 2 files, 242 passed: `protocol.graft-folded-form-sections`, `view-container-runtime-expansion`. Its source has no runtime caller of `translateView`, only a comment.
    - `@objectstack/platform-objects` `invite-user-action-copy`, 34 passed. `@objectstack/service-i18n` `authored-translations`, 16 passed.
  - No consumer fixture asserted an untranslated section.

## Gates

The local subset is `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on this diff: 84 families. Each exit code was captured before any pipe, and the record was reconciled with `--ran`: `84 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 83 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED`. 83 exit 0. The one NOT MEASURED is `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it reads every package's `dist/`, and this worktree built only the closure of `@objectstack/rest`. CI runs it. Two families first answered exit 3 and gave their verdict, exit 0, once their prerequisites were met: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` after fetching its pinned fixture commit, and `check:doc-formula-expressions` / `check:lean-entry-closure` once their packages were built. The local-only `check:dev-prereqs` gives exit 0. Every family CI runs is read from this PR's check runs, not re-run here.

Not done before opening: `origin/main` is 7 commits past this branch's base. None of them touches a file in this diff or `i18n-resolver.ts` / `view.zod.ts`: the spec files they change are migration entries and `api/protocol.zod.ts`. This diff changes no generated artifact either. The PR's CI runs on the merge ref.

## Ablation (one per rule, each restored and proven by blob hash == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`)

The suite imports `./i18n-resolver` relatively (source, not `dist/`), so no rebuild sits between mutation and run. Each mutation went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, whose anchor must hit exactly once.

| mutation | result |
|:---|:---|
| `translateFormSections` returns its input (`return changed ? next : sections;` → `return sections;`) | 8 failed / 5 passed. The 5 that stay green are the ones whose expectation is "unchanged". |
| object binding ignores `config.data.object` | 2 failed (the retargeted-form case and the label-only-key case) / 11 passed |
| only-authored-copy guard removed | 1 failed (`never adds a heading or a description`) / 12 passed |

## Acceptance notes (observations, not filed)

- **`FormSectionSchema.name` TSDoc names the wrong namespace for an object-bound form view.** It says a bundle targets the section via `metadataForms.TYPE.sections.NAME`. That holds for a metadata-editing form (`defineForm({ schemaId })`). The renderers, the extractor, the linter and now this resolver all address an object-bound form view's section under `objects.OBJECT._sections.NAME`. The `.describe()` string names no namespace. Doc drift outside this card's file surface. Carrier: none.
- **Neither the extractor nor the linter walks a ViewItem record's `config.sections`.** `walkObjectSections` and `collectViewRecord` read a view record's top-level `sections`, `form` and `formViews`, never `config.sections` of an authored `{ name, object, viewKind: 'form', config }` record. No source producer of such a form record exists in this tree (`git grep "viewKind: 'form'"` over `examples`, `packages/platform-objects`, `packages/plugins`, `apps`: zero hits outside tests), so nothing reaches it. Read-only inference, not filed. Carrier: none.
- **A localized `/meta/view` read now serves section copy translated.** This is the intended reach. An editor that read a view with a locale and saved that body back would persist the translation. The view `label` and the bulk-action defs already have that exposure on the same read, so this widens it to one more key and does not change its kind.
- **The other half of the card.** `GET /forms/:slug` still serves `form` untranslated until #23497 makes the call above. #23497 is not addressed here.
